title: Ben & Jerry's CEO 谈品牌立场与业务模式
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: It's such an interesting time to be a corporation with, like, this ethos of concern about the world about things like climate and racial inequality in a world that feels increasingly
segments.zh: 当下做企业很有意思，要关心气候、种族不平等，而世界却越来越

segments.en: divided, be it by social media, be it otherwise, and I also, by the way, is increasingly deeply distrusting of corporate America.
segments.zh: 分裂，无论是社交媒体还是其他原因，而且我也越来越不信任美国企业。

segments.en: What does that mean for you to operate in such a divided climate? So, Danny, what a great question, by the way.
segments.zh: 在这样分裂的环境中运营，对你意味着什么？丹尼，这个问题问得好。

segments.en: I started this job about a year ago, and I worked for Ben and Jerry's before, and one of the reasons why I love this job, because we are a failure-based company.
segments.zh: 我大约一年前开始这份工作，之前就在Ben & Jerry's工作过，我喜欢这份工作的原因之一是我们是一家以失败为基础的公司。

segments.en: And if you're a failure-based and failure-less, and really articulate it as well in a three-pack mission, product making it in the nicest possible way, a social mission which comes through
segments.zh: 如果你以失败为基础，并且能清晰地用三部分使命来阐述：产品以最好的方式制作，社会使命则通过

segments.en: our, you know, the things we stand for and how we source.
segments.zh: 我们所坚持的东西和采购方式体现出来。

segments.en: And then it all sits in a business mall, and that model actually really, really works.
segments.zh: 然后这一切都建立在商业模式上，这个模式真的非常有效。

segments.en: And, you know, we're doing the job, and even when the times change, you know, what we are proving and showing and getting again, is that we can be out there and actually connect to communities,
segments.zh: 我们正在做这件事，即使时代变化，我们再次证明和展示的是，我们可以走出去，真正连接社区，

segments.en: have a point of view, and it works for our business as well, because we grew in quarter to 9.2 percent.
segments.zh: 有自己的观点，这对我们的业务也有利，因为我们季度增长了9.2%。

segments.en: So, the business works really well, and at the same time, we're out there to actually, you know, support democracy, you know, in the upbeat to the midterms.
segments.zh: 所以，业务运作得很好，同时我们也在那里支持民主，你知道，在中期选举之前。

segments.en: There are a lot of external pressures and this government and this administration being one of them.
segments.zh: 外部压力很多，本届政府和这届行政当局就是其中之一。

segments.en: A lot of companies quietly dismantled their ESG and DEI programs because of that pressure.
segments.zh: 许多公司因这种压力悄悄拆解了ESG和DEI项目。

segments.en: Are you not facing some of the same constraints from governments, from otherwise?
segments.zh: 你们是否也面临来自政府或其他方面的类似限制？
